# CBAMValid — Self-Service Emissions Data Software

> CBAMValid (https://cbamvalid.com) is privately operated self-service B2B software for customer-entered emissions data, deterministic calculations, automated quality controls, and automated PDF, JSON and XLSX delivery.

## Product positioning

- CBAMValid Self-Service Emissions Data Software — Customer-Controlled Data and Automated Digital Delivery
- Pricing: $449 per CBAMValid Working File Software Unlock (one-time; no subscription; unlimited drafts; 1 installation; 1 reporting year; same-file correction re-locks included).

## Product boundary

CBAMValid is privately operated self-service B2B software. Customers enter and control their own data, and remain responsible for external submissions and any independent review required for their workflow.

## Key regulatory facts

- The CBAM definitive period applies from 1 January 2026.
- For 2026 imports, the first CBAM declaration and corresponding certificate surrender deadline is 30 September 2027.
- In 2026, CBAM certificate prices are calculated on a quarterly cadence.

## Authoritative source families

- REG_2023_956: Regulation (EU) 2023/956
- REG_2025_2083: Regulation (EU) 2025/2083
- IMPL_2025_2546: Verification principles for declared embedded emissions
- IMPL_2025_2547: Methods for calculating emissions embedded in goods
- IMPL_2025_2548: Calculation and publication of CBAM certificate prices

## Scope limitations

- Outputs are generated from customer-entered data
- Customers manage external submissions and third-party review independently
- The software does not issue accredited opinions or authority acceptance
- No synthetic customer counts, ratings, or testimonials
